name: Theft & Package Tampering Incident
rationale: An unauthorized individual wearing a dark hoodie is detected near the exit portal approaching an unattended equipment package located in the restricted target zone, demonstrating suspicious intent and behavior consistent with property theft.
description: Unauthorized individual in dark hoodie approaches unattended equipment package near door, reaches down, conceals item, and retreats.

name: Restricted Perimeter Boundary Breach
rationale: An unauthorized individual is detected within the restricted target zone after hours, actively bypassing security parameters as indicated by the bounding box and spatial telemetry.
description: Intruder bypasses physical corridor boundary barrier after hours, crouching and rapidly moving past security lasers.

name: Suspicious Entryway Loitering
rationale: An unidentified individual is detected loitering near a secure entryway and restricted asset zone, displaying suspicious behavior such as examining locks and peering into windows, warranting a medium-severity security alert.
description: Unidentified individual loiters near secure entryway for extended duration, repeatedly peering into window and checking locks.

name: Normal Routine Hallway Foot Traffic
rationale: The surveillance feed shows an authorized individual walking casually at a steady pace through the north hallway carrying a coffee mug, exhibiting entirely normal behavior with no indicators of security anomalies or threats.
description: Authorized facility occupant walking casually through main hallway at steady pace, holding coffee mug, no anomalies.

name: Scheduled Security Officer Patrol
rationale: Visual analysis confirms a uniformed security officer is conducting a standard floor inspection and verifying door integrity within the corridor. Bounding box and status overlays correctly classify the individual as authorized security personnel performing routine duties with no indicators of threat or unauthorized access.
description: Uniformed security officer conducting routine floor inspection, verifying door integrity in accordance with protocol.

name: Clean Corridor Monitored Clear Zone
rationale: Comprehensive spatial security assessment confirms the corridor is completely unoccupied. Secure baseline conditions are maintained with 100% optical visibility, static environmental features, and zero physical motion detected.
description: Corridor unoccupied. Secure baseline conditions maintained with 100% optical visibility and no physical motion detected.
